verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm Trivy runs in CI pipelines and is easy to automate, and a first-party aquasecurity/trivy-action exists for GitHub workflows. However, the pack never documents exit-code behavior for failing builds, per-pull-request triggering, or detecting only new findings against a baseline. missing for 10: documented exit-code/fail-on-severity controls, per-PR workflow documentation, new-vs-existing finding baseline/diffing, first-party CI integration docs.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run scans in CI on every pull request and fail the build on new findings via exit codes

citations.quote: it's super easy to integrate in every ci/cd pipeline
we only use it in our CI and this covers our requirements
very easy to write automation around
installed the aquasecurity/trivy-action dependency by tag rather than by sha
